project: Mario Strikers Charged native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays a VS match at about 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: a VS match, 57.9 fps with some hitches (10 frames over 34 ms in 37 s, the longest 65 ms)). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
